files.content: "use client" import { Card, CardContent } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const tips = [ "Drink water before your draw.", "Skip intense exercise the day before.", "Bring a list of your supplements.", "Wear a top with loose sleeves.", ] export function CarouselVertical() { return ( {tips.map((tip) => ( {tip} ))} ) }
